D.comparison: peers entering teaching through different programs

cells.quote: Among its key findings, the study revealed that the retention rates of novice TRP teachers were roughly the same as those of their peers who entered the profession through different programs. For example, 92 percent of the former remained in the same district, compared with 90 percent of the latter.
cells.note: The supplied study text reports the retention comparison but does not state the study design or statistical significance/power.

D.treatment: three-week training based on TQM principles

O.outcome_detail: perceptions of the applicability of TQM principles in participants' schools

cells.quote: Mann -Whitney U test was found that it was statistically significant between post- test scores about the perceptions of experimental and control groups. The result of this post-test showed that the level of perception of the experimental group was less than the control group.
cells.note: The study states that participants had low awareness, readiness, or basic knowledge of TQM practices before the intervention; assignment was not reported as random.

O.outcome_detail: Perceived applicability of TQM principles in schools at post-test

cells.quote: Mann -Whitney U test was found that it was statistically significant between post- test scores about the perceptions of experimental and control groups. The result of this post-test showed that the level of perception of the experimental group was less than the control group. Training with Total Quality Management affected the perceptions of experimental group and they evaluated to be lower than control group the TQM practices and efforts in their schools according to TQM principles learned.
cells.note: The lower post-test scores were interpreted by the authors as more negative evaluations of existing TQM practices.

O.outcome_detail: Perceived applicability of TQM principles in the experimental group

cells.quote: According to Table 4, experimental group's pre-test and post-test mean scores were calculated with Wilcoxon signed rank test. The difference between the pre- test and post -test scores of the control group were determined that there was statistically significant. According to Cohen's d (T=3,75,  z=-4.171, p=0.00, r=0,83) effect size is large level (0.75 < r < 1.10). Post -test scores of the perceptions of participants in the experimental group about the applicabi lity of TQM principles decreased.
cells.note: The study text mistakenly says 'control group' in the explanation of Table 4; the table and surrounding section identify this as the experimental group.

O.outcome_detail: Perceived applicability of TQM principles in the control group

cells.quote: The difference between the pre- test and post -test mean scores of the control group were determined that there was statistically not significant. Post- test scores of the perceptions of participants in the control group about the applicability of TQM principles partially increased.
cells.note: The non-significant result is coded ns because no equivalence test or adequate-power justification was reported.
